comments.headline: Four water review comments cleared without explanation
comments.summary: Four water review comment entries are marked 'Cleared' but contain no substantive content, explanation, or standard response documentation. Applicants cannot understand what requirements were satisfied or how the review addressed their submission.

details.text: Comment entries OWB1, OWB3, OWB4, and OWB5 contain only 'Cleared' status headers with no comment text, regulatory explanations, or U0/U1 response documentation. All other review entries follow the standard format (Status header + initial comment + update response); these four violate that convention entirely.

runComments.comment: Comments OWB1, OWB3, OWB4, and OWB5 in the AW OWB Review section are marked as 'Cleared' with no substantive comment body, bullet points, or explanation of what regulatory requirements were satisfied. These entries provide no information to the applicant about what deficiency or requirement was addressed.

Comment entries OWB1, OWB3, OWB4, and OWB5 are entirely empty, containing only a status header ("Current Status: Cleared") with no comment text, U0 updates, or U1 responses. These entries provide no information to the applicant about the requirement or how it was addressed. All other comments in the review record follow the standard format of Status header + U0 initial comment + U1 update response; these four entries violate that pattern by containing zero substantive content.
